calculation.formula: available = provider_available − active reservations recorded after the snapshot basis
shortfall = max(0, requested − available)
allocate free stock once across orders in declared priority; own reservations are not unavailable to their own order
remaining_obligation = quantity − cancelled − dispatched; variance = active_reserved − remaining_obligation
follow revised supply promise through explicit allocation links to orders; compare with customer deadline
attention = carrier exception OR scan age > stale threshold OR forecast passed OR label without handover
overdue = not delivered AND promised_at < now; at risk = forecast after promise or inside the configured window
remaining_to_dispatch = ordered − cancelled − handed_over; remaining_to_deliver = ordered − cancelled − delivered (labels count as neither)

prior_communications.summary: We will update you after the next scan.

calculation.formula: structured evidenced facts only; no promise or apology is invented; sending is never automatic
reported_open = gross − credits − reported payment markers (markers are not cash; negative = credit/overpayment, not negative debt)
orders satisfying the invoicing trigger without a valid issued invoice (partial invoices listed separately)
difference = invoice covered gross − agreed covered gross (same currency, no conversion)
provider-reported send evidence per finalized invoice; absence is not proof of unsent
collected = confirmed captures; remaining = max(0, obligation − collected); authorizations and failures reported separately
recovered = later confirmed captures >= required amount; all attempts retained
remaining = invoice − credits − allocated gross customer payments; provider fees never reduce the customer payment
due net receivables (open > 0, due_date <= now) with case/extension flags; a queue, never automatic dunning
provider_balance = captured − fees − refunds − payouts sent − chargebacks + adjustments; net_assets = balance + in_transit + bank_confirmed; unknown components are reported, never zeroed
computed_net = captures − fees − refunds + other adjustments (payout members only); unexplained = payout − computed_net
a sent payout is confirmed only by a uniquely evidenced booked bank credit (reference/currency/amount); pending, ambiguous and out-of-interval cases are reported separately
held = current hold amount − released (current versions only); a promised release is not a release
requested, received, quarantined and restocked quantities are independent; refund money/status is separate; a request is not a receipt
cash_refund_due = approved cash entitlement − completed refunds on the same original payment; credit documents alone create no repayment
independent reservation/stock/invoice/payment checks at one cutoff; a cancellation never reverses a shipment or payment by itself
net repayments = completed refunds + booked chargeback debits − reversals (fees excluded); excess = max(0, net − capture); open disputes and fees are not completed refunds

checks.name: not cancelled (no cancellation observed, nothing invented)
